prompt: A penthouse apartment tour with an agent who books a viewing

intent.setting: A luxurious penthouse apartment with a living area, kitchen, bedrooms, and a terrace, staged for viewing. The floor plan uses a central main room with a yard/entrance, a main living space, and four side rooms (bedroom, office, study, and a bathroom/utility).
intent.goal: Tour the penthouse, inspect key rooms and features, and ask the agent for booking details.
intent.fail: No explicit fail state; the tour simply ends without a booking if the viewer does not engage.
intent.mood: Aspirational, polished, slightly tense with the prospect of a high-stakes purchase
intent.headline: Penthouse tour includes a terrace and booking prompt

headline.text: Penthouse tour includes a terrace and booking prompt

chips.method: physics, an AI visitor walks to and uses each
chips.text: walked to and inspected 8 of 8 things
